Dear Sir/Madam, 
 
Pursuant to Regulation 30 and 33 of the Securities and Exchange Board of India (Listing Obligations 
and Disclosure Requirements) Regulations, 2015 (“SEBI LODR Regulations”), we wish to inform you 
that the Meeting of the Board of Directors of Galaxy Agrico Exports Ltd. was held on Friday, 14th 
August, 2026 at the Registered Office of the Company, wherein the Board has, inter alia, considered 
and approved the following: 
 
1. Approval of Unaudited Financial Results of the Company for quarter ended June 30, 2026, 
along with the Limited Review Report issued by the Statutory Auditors of the Company. 
 
The meeting of the Board of Directors commenced at 05:00P.M. and concluded at 06:30 P.M. 
 
The Unaudited Financial Results and Limited Review Report will be submitted separately in the 
prescribed format as per SEBI LODR Regulations. 
 
Kindly take the above on your record and acknowledge the receipt. 
 
Thanking you, 
 
Sincerely, 
For Galaxy Agrico Exports Ltd. 
 
 
 
 
Mr. Prashant Sudhir Khairnar
